basic_details.post_name: Postdoctoral Fellow-Snake venom Research, Embedded IoT Engineer, Soft Skills Trainer & Placement Officer, STEM Project Manager (PM)

qualification.details: Postdoctoral Fellow-Snake venom Research: Ph.D. in Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Molecular Biology, Proteomics, Pharmacology, Toxicology, Immunology, Bioinformatics, or a related life sciences discipline. Embedded IoT Engineer: B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. Soft Skills Trainer & Placement Officer: Graduate/Postgraduate in Management, HR, Psychology, English, Education, Communication, or any relevant discipline. Relevant experience in training, recruitment, or placement coordination preferred. STEM Project Manager (PM): Master’s degree required - a degree/diploma in engineering education, project management, or a related field is preferred.

selection_process: Please refer to the official notification for selection process details.

To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.

Pay the application fee online, if applicable.

Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham for various positions including Postdoctoral Fellow, Embedded IoT Engineer, Soft Skills Trainer, and STEM Project Manager.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies available across different positions announced in the notification by Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications for the advertised posts is 10 October 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Postdoctoral Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. in Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Molecular Biology, Proteomics, Pharmacology, Toxicology, Immunology, Bioinformatics, or a related life sciences discipline.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for the Embedded IoT Engineer position?
faq.answer: Applicants must hold a B.Tech or M.Tech degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a closely related technical field.

faq.question: Q6. Are there vacancies for management or HR graduates?
faq.answer: Yes, the Soft Skills Trainer & Placement Officer position requires a Graduate or Postgraduate degree in Management, HR, Psychology, English, Education, Communication, or any relevant discipline.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly online. Candidates must apply through the official Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham careers portal using the provided links.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No application fee details are mentioned in the official notification released by Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham for these roles.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location for these positions?
faq.answer: The jobs are located in Kollam, Kerala, at the campus and facilities of Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I access the official website and notification link?
faq.answer: You can check the official website at https://www.amrita.edu and find direct links in the important links section of this article.
